source.prompt: Instrumental background music for a classic 1990s-style Japanese fantasy role-playing game. The writing and orchestration evoke the golden age of 16-bit console RPG soundtracks (memorable singable lead melody, clear bass line, warm chords, tasteful hall reverb), but the production is high quality, warm and full, recorded with real-sounding instruments. Completely original melody. A mystical deep forest and a thousand-year-old tree: gentle wonder, mist between giant trunks, a place that remembers old songs. Tempo 92 BPM, 4/4 time, key of D minor. Instrumentation: wooden flute and harp, soft hand percussion, marimba droplets, strings, kalimba. Form: harp intro, flute theme, marimba interlude, theme again. Duration: 75 seconds. Instrumental only: no vocals, no singing, no spoken words, no lyrics. Keep one steady tempo and key from start to finish, no fade-in and no fade-out, no long silences; the last bar leads naturally back into the first bar so the piece loops seamlessly as game background music.
